verified_facts.text: AutoSkill's OpenClaw usage tracker preserves a retrieval snapshot containing selected_for_context_ids and selected_for_use_ids, then links that pending retrieval to a session-level usage update rather than treating retrieval itself as executed uptake.

The first-party agent-end write path records explicit used_skill_ids and inferred_used_skill_ids together with success/task_success/objective_met for the same session, so retrieved, selected-for-use, observed uptake, and task outcome are separately observable states.

SkillEvo reconstructs per-skill replay pools from online and offline provenance, binds them to a stable lineage_id and skill_id/version timeline, and writes replay, judgment, promotion, and provenance artifacts for later variant evaluation.
